notes: Timeline = gapless mp3 decode (same as data/audio.json); the Demucs stems are separated from that decode. A 'word' is one Chinese character. Method: (1) CTC emissions (20 ms frames) of the Demucs vocal stem from torchaudio MMS_FA, on the mono sum and on the left and right channels, fused as a probability mixture; (2) one global constrained Viterbi forced alignment of all lines over the whole song with a garbage 'star' token between lines to absorb ad-libs, every character aligned as its toneless pinyin; (3) signal refinement per character on the vocal stem: start moved to the voice re-entry after a rest, snapped to the nearest spectral-flux onset, or moved back to the start of the frication of an s/sh/c/ch/z/zh/x/q/j/f/h initial; ends = next character start when legato, else when the voice drops 15 dB below the character's level (held notes keep their full length). conf: 0.35 + agreement of the mono / left / right alignments (<=60 ms) + CTC posterior; manual fixes (align.py FIX) carry their own conf.
